verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a code-execution sandbox product, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a Vercel-managed service: sandboxes run in Vercel regions (iad1, sfo1, cle1, cdg1), use metered billing, and pull images from Vercel Container Registry. Nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core sandbox runtime; running the SDK from non-Vercel environments with access tokens is still a client of the hosted service.
